**What would change**, and which spec section or decision record (`docs/spec/`, `docs/missions/01-architecture-decisions/`)

**Why**

**Who else it affects:** other EIN apps and nodes that read or publish this

**How it stays compatible:** a namespace of its own, or why a breaking change is worth it

Starcom is one implementation among several: a shared format changes through the spec and its vectors, never in place.
